scope: Fourteenth additive botanical identity shard. Additional high-area R4 links where authoritative registry spellings differ from Adelaide only by registered spelling or color-code conventions.

grapegen06-dimyat-5716-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - European Grapevine Catalogue, Annex 1B
grapegen06-dimyat-5716-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen prime identity DIMYAT is VIVC 5716 and Bulgarian Dimjat is registered beneath it. Adelaide's English transliteration Dimyat is therefore treated as R4, not an exact source assertion.

grapegen06-malvasia-bianca-candia-7258-2.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - European Grapevine Catalogue, Annex 1B
grapegen06-malvasia-bianca-candia-7258-2.notes: GrapeGen maps Italian Malvasia bianca di Candia B. to MALVASIA CANDIDA, VIVC 7258. The Adelaide row omits the color code and is linked conservatively at R4.
